Caution - barely coherent ramble ahead

I wasn't suicidal as kid. But I had no plans to live beyond my thirties. Who wants to live forever right? I fully appreciate that doesn't make me unique in any way, but I made a pretty good attempt at shortening my life (drugs, booze, smoking, etc etc). The flame that burns twice as bright burns half as long.

As I got older, despite what my parents insisted would happen, the desire to prolong my life never developed. And as I got older still, and it seemed apparent that an early death was not on the cards, my thoughts turned to suicide as a viable option.

But then ... life. It all happened so fast. Wife, kids, house, pension, blah blah. By the time I realised what was happening it was too late. I was trapped.

With actively killing myself off the table (too much damage to the family), I need to be creative. My options are 1) kill myself and make it look like an accident. Or 2) shorten my life somehow by other means. It has turned into something of a game. This might make me sound like an asshole as, for many, I know it's anything but. It is what it is though. We are all here for different reason.

To some extent I can play the old bipolar card. It's a useful excuse for behaving like a cunt. That said, there's no doubt I'm heading towards a manic episode - I'm genuinely not hiding behind some made up mental health problem.

The obvious method would be smoking and drinking myself to death. Ironically, I quit drinking six months ago and quit smoking three months ago - starting again would be a little obvious. I could start again on the D-low, but death by lung cancer/cirrhosis is really not appealing. So I'm taking a more imaginative approach. I'm making other lifestyle changes to shorten my life. I've mentioned before my plan to blow my heart up while running. This is still plan A. But I've recently started thinking about other ways to speed up the process or at least to make sure that plan A actually works. I'm not looking for suggestions, just trying to spark conversation really.

Is a 'live fast, die young' cavalier approach to life akin to being suicidal. Are daredevils just suicidal people that haven't the guts to pull the trigger? Am I just a big pussy without enough conviction in my desire to die?

I think live fast die young can get you where you're going a lot quicker, but just as some might live that life not caring if they live or die, some live that way because it makes them feel alive and they love the thrill.

I know I want to kill myself. At the same time I really don't want to act violently against myself... so I'm just riding things out, until something takes me, or something helps remove my fear / dulls me to the point I don't care what I do to myself.

Have you ever been able to discuss any of this with your wife? Obviously I'm not suggesting it if you think she'll be reactionary, or take measures to limit your will. I'm just curious if you've ever been able to.

When I was drinking I told her I wanted to kill myself. It was one of the reasons I stopped - to show some willing to 'fix' myself. We haven't discussed it in a long time. Either she doesn't know or isn't willing to accept there's a problem with me. Either way I don't like discussing it with anyone IRL. I told my psychiatrist and the had to convince him that I would never go through with it for fear of being locked up.

I'm taking my meds, staying sober, putting a smile on ... and plotting ... always plotting.

Man, I'm sorry to hear that. What a shame that there is the threat of being locked up just for being honest about your feelings. Like that threat is going to make any of us like this damn place any more.

I'm extremely lucky that I have one friend who gets all this and discusses it openly with me.

Glad you share here. You have good insights. Good luck with the day-to-day, man.

Glad you've given us a place to talk about it bud
